description:
Files a request with MTD Chase when the user asks for something none of the other tools can do, or adds a vote to a matching open request; returns its ID, status and any workaround with existing tools. No date is promised.
Use this when: the practitioner wants a capability MTD Chase doesn't have.
Not for: reporting a single Client's problem.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

urgency.description: blocking = they can't do the job today; nice_to_have = a workaround exists

name: request_feature
title: Request a feature
